commands: echo "=== is .prflow/vendor tracked? ==="; git ls-files '.prflow/vendor/*' | head -3; echo "vendor-tracked-count: $(git ls-files '.prflow/vendor/*' | wc -l)"; echo "=== .gitignore for vendor ==="; git check-ignore .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/render-pr-provenance-line.py || echo "(not ignored)"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "::warning::snapshot failed" >&2
  rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
